summary: Sugarcane dues, stray animals damaging crops and farmers' complaints about power-department checks dominate complaints in Garhmukteshwar, while the only sourced delivered benefit is the Ganga Expressway opening.

positives.english: Inference: Repair work on broken Garhmukteshwar roads may start after tenders were issued
positives.hindi: * टूटी सड़कों के टेंडर निकले हैं, अब काम शुरू होने का इंतजार
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (5 May 2025) reports Hapur-Pilkhuwa Development Authority tenders for repair of the Jawaharganj Mandi road in Garhmukteshwar (Rs 55.56 lakh) and two Brajghat roads (Rs 95.07 lakh and Rs 64.62 lakh); work was planned to start in June. The article does not say Brajghat is in the town. No start or completion is confirmed, and the source is from 2025.

positives.english: Inference: Police posts were set up at the Ganga Fair ghats for security
positives.hindi: * गंगा मेले में हर घाट पर पुलिस चौकी बनी, सुरक्षा का इंतजाम हुआ
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (2 Nov 2025) reports police stations and chowkis in every sector and at every ghat, dog squads, metal detectors, and strict security around the women's ghats at the Garhmukteshwar Ganga fair. The article does not say watch towers are at the women's ghats. It has no devotee feedback, so how people felt about it is not sourced.

positives.english: Ganga Expressway has opened, with a Hapur-Garhmukteshwar interchange in Phase 1
positives.hindi: गंगा एक्सप्रेसवे चालू हो गया, गढ़मुक्तेश्वर का इंटरचेंज भी है
positives.basis: District-level: Wikipedia says the Ganga Expressway was inaugurated on 29 April 2026 and lists a Phase 1 diamond interchange at NH-24 (Hapur-Garhmukteshwar). The page does not say how the interchange affects travel in Garhmukteshwar, so the local benefit is not stated by the source.

positives.english: Inference: better village roads would make it easier to reach fields and mandis
positives.hindi: * गांवों तक के रास्ते सुधरें तो खेत और मंडी तक पहुंच आसान हो
positives.basis: Inference: Khabarwala (8 Oct 2026) reports BKU demanding repair of dilapidated village roads in Garhmukteshwar tehsil. No source found that these roads have been repaired, so improvement is a hope, not a delivered benefit.

positives.english: Inference: police patrols and chowkis give people a sense of safety
positives.hindi: * पुलिस चौकियों और गश्त से लोगों को सुरक्षा का भरोसा मिले
positives.basis: Inference: the Ganga Fair police arrangements are sourced (positive 2). No source records public feeling of safety in the AC, so this is a guess.

negatives.english: Sugarcane mills have not paid farmers' dues, and farmers are stuck in debt
negatives.hindi: मिलों पर गन्ने का पैसा अटका है, किसान कर्ज़ के बोझ तले दबा है
negatives.basis: Khabarwala (8 Oct 2026): BKU tractor march and dharna at Garhmukteshwar tehsil, demanding payment of cane dues with interest and a higher cane price for the new season. Source says: 'समय पर पैसा न मिलने से किसान कर्ज के बोझ तले दब रहा है'. No amount owed, mill name or payment schedule is stated. The protest was at tehsil premises; Wikipedia's Garhmukteshwar page says the tehsil headquarters is in the town (AC namesake), so it is counted as AC-specific.

negatives.english: Stray cattle and monkeys are destroying crops
negatives.hindi: आवारा गोवंश और बंदर फसल चौपट कर रहे हैं
negatives.basis: Khabarwala (8 Oct 2026): same BKU protest at Garhmukteshwar tehsil demanded relief from stray cattle and monkeys damaging standing crops. No count of animals or area is stated. Tehsil-wide demand; AC membership of the specific place is not confirmed, so not counted as AC-specific.

negatives.english: Ganga water has risen and parts of Garhmukteshwar are in flood-like conditions
negatives.hindi: गंगा का पानी बढ़ा, गढ़मुक्तेश्वर के कई इलाकों में बाढ़ जैसे हालात
negatives.basis: Asianet Newsable (23 Aug 2026, 12:03 PM IST) states: 'The rising water level of the Ganga has triggered a flood-like situation in parts of Garhmukteshwar, Hapur, Uttar Pradesh.' No villages, ghats, roads or figures are named. Named place is the AC namesake town.

negatives.english: Farmers allege the power department harasses them during checks in rural areas
negatives.hindi: बिजली विभाग जांच के नाम पर किसानों को परेशान करने का आरोप है
negatives.basis: Allegation only, as put in the BKU memorandum (Khabarwala, 8 Oct 2026): the power department harasses farmers in rural areas under the cover of checking. The source does not use the words 'power theft'. Tehsil-wide; AC membership unconfirmed; no village or case named. Not counted as AC-specific.

negatives.english: Dirt and disorder seen at the Kanwar Yatra fair area in Garhmukteshwar
negatives.hindi: कांवड़ मेला क्षेत्र में गंदगी और अव्यवस्था दिखी
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala video page (29 Jul 2026): Divisional Commissioner inspected the Kanwar mela area at Brijghat, Garhmukteshwar, said 'यह क्या तैयारी है, हम यहां ये अव्यवस्था देखने के लिए आए हैं', and found dirt and disorder at several places (no spots named). The article text is cut off. Brijghat is placed inside the AC by Bharatpedia (aggregator): 'Nagar Palika Parishad Garhmukteshwar (City + Brijghat)'.

round2.changes: Fetched all 6 cited pages plus Wikipedia (AC and town) and Bharatpedia. Positive 1 (road tender only, not started) and positive 2 (Ganga Fair police arrangements; no devotee appreciation in source) changed to inference with *. Negative 4 reworded: source says 'checking', not 'power theft'; Hindi trimmed to 13 words. Negative 1 now counted AC-specific via Wikipedia tehsil HQ in town. Removed the unverified 2026 police-arrest claim from positive 5 basis. Expressway basis states the source does not show local benefit. AC extent retried: Wikipedia AC page has no extent; Bharatpedia (aggregator) lists Nagar Palika Garhmukteshwar (city + Brijghat), Garhmukteshwar and Simbhaoli block villages (except Asra and Muradpur Nizamsar) and some Hapur block villages; used only for Brijghat.

notes: AC identity confirmed from Wikipedia: No. 60 Garhmukteshwar, Hapur district, reserved None. The Wikipedia AC page has no extent list, so AC membership is only partly confirmed: the town (Nagar Palika, per Bharatpedia aggregator, which also names Brijghat as inside the AC) and the town itself. Villages of Garhmukteshwar and Simbhaoli blocks are in the AC per Bharatpedia, but no village named in sources is confirmed in the AC. Simbhaoli mill was not used: its inclusion is unconfirmed. The sugarcane negative still has no amount, mill name or payment schedule. Searches (about 14, Hindi and English) found no Garhmukteshwar-specific reports on sugarcane dues, stray cattle, road completion, power checks, health facilities, or town drainage. Positives are thin: only the Ganga Expressway is a sourced delivered project, and it is district-level. Khabarwala24 has no exact publish date; 8 Oct 2026 is its 'Last Update'. Amar Ujala Ganga Fair article: police arrangements sourced, no appreciation. Kisantak and Newstrack were not used earlier (HTTP 403). Hapur city waterlogging stories are about the city, not this AC, and were not used. Field check needed on road works, Ganga flood status and sugarcane dues amounts, and whether the Garhmukteshwar tehsil office sits in the AC town.
